A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref3-D-blockadeflagshiphallway-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Blockade Flagship: Hallway (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The game text changes: “your” is added after “If you occupy,”; “is” is added after “occupy, Force generation”; “for you” is removed. The slip no longer prints the title in its black strip; the “E” stays at the lower right.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, both as cut from their sheets at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
